rootCauseOneLine: Tasks plugin frontend (FolderRow/FoldersSection in plugins/tasks/views/manage/manage-panel.tsx and the sidebar) never calls the existing deleteFolder RPC, and the bb tasks CLI has no `folder delete` verb either, so a folder can only be removed via a raw POST /api/v1/plugins/tasks/rpc/deleteFolder.

prReviews.topFinding: UI change is correct, tested (36 files/333 tests + typecheck pass; live browser delete verified with correct '1 project and 1 subfolder move to the top level' copy), but the PR description's claim that the CLI surface already exists is false: `bb tasks folder` has only create|list|update (unknown folder subcommand: delete). AGENTS.md requires the CLI surface (`bb tasks folder delete <id-or-name>` + FOLDER_HELP/README) in the same change. Minor: extra useProjects() subscription on Manage just for the confirm copy.

proposedFix: (1) App: add a trash button to FolderRow and a ConfirmDialog in FoldersSection calling rpc.call('deleteFolder',{folderId}) via the existing run() error wrapper, with copy naming the re-parenting outcome (PR #1703 does this). (2) CLI: add `bb tasks folder delete <id-or-name> [--json]` in runFolder (resolveFolder -> domain.deleteFolder -> publishProjectsChanged), update FOLDER_HELP/ROOT_HELP and plugins/tasks/README.md row 72. No wire/protocol change; refresh already flows through projects:changed.
caveats: Worktree HEAD was a108fa7ef (5 commits ahead of base, none touching plugins/tasks); I checked out 16ceb3a54 for the repro. origin/main has no tasks-plugin changes since base, so not already fixed. The issue's claim that the CLI exposes folder deletion is refuted. Labels-tab screenshot shows the trash icon only in the DOM dump because it is hover-revealed. Reproduced on Linux, not macOS/0.38.0 as reported.
